name: Economic Investment Certificate (EIC)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a Qualifying Investment of at least BM$2.5 million into the Bermudian economy, maintained for a minimum of 5 years. Qualifying investment types include real estate, new business development, government bonds, the Sinking Fund, the Bermuda Trust Fund, registered charities, equity in existing businesses, or other Minister-approved ventures benefiting Bermuda.
requirements.fix_path: Make and maintain a qualifying investment of at least BM$2.5 million for 5 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be at least 18 years old, of good character, with no indictable convictions.

outcome.duration_length: does not expire while the investment and residency requirements are maintained
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: minimum 90 days in Bermuda each calendar year for 5 years

sources.title: Government of Bermuda -- Economic Investment and Residential Certificate Policy Revision: confirms the BM$2.5 million minimum qualifying investment, and a March 2023 revision letting the Minister waive the prior 5-year wait before a Residential Certificate can be granted

Conyers Dill & Pearman (Bermuda law firm) -- Establishing Bermuda Residence: corroborates the 90-day/year physical presence requirement, $2,755 fee, character requirements, and 'does not expire if maintained' duration, citing Bermuda Immigration and Protection Act (BIPA)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Bermuda's initial build. Published rather than draft because the core investment-amount hard requirement is confirmed directly by a Government of Bermuda article (a primary announcement of the policy, not third-party reporting) -- this differs from ky_direct_investment_certificate.json and ky_persons_independent_means.json in the Cayman build, where the equivalent thresholds could only be sourced at tier-3. The 90-day/year physical presence detail is corroborated only at tier-3 (Conyers) and is therefore placed in outcome.physical_presence_requirement (a descriptive field) rather than modelled as its own separately-sourced hard requirement, to avoid a sourcing mismatch on a published route. This certificate leads to eligibility for a Residential Certificate (Bermuda's route to indefinite/permanent status via this investment track) -- as of the March 2023 policy revision, the Minister can grant this without waiting the full 5 years, though the standard expectation remains 5 years of maintained investment and residence; pr_after_months is modelled as 0 to reflect that ministerial discretion can grant it immediately, while fix_time_months on the investment requirement (60 months) reflects the standard expectation. This is the direct successor to what several tier-3/4 sources call the 'Bermuda golden visa' or citizenship-by-investment program -- Bermuda has no citizenship-by-investment; this certificate leads only to residency and, separately, is not confirmed to shorten the path to Bermudian status or British Naturalisation (see bm_naturalisation_botc.json).
